item.title: keybind
item.description:
Declarative Keybindings in Bubble Tea: A Guide to the bubbles/key Package

Building a rich, interactive terminal user interface (TUI) with Bubble Tea is a rewarding experience. As your application grows beyond simple views, you’ll inevitably need to handle user input in a structured, maintainable way. While you can handle tea.KeyMsg events directly with a switch statement, this can become cumbersome, especially when dealing with multiple components, context-sensitive actions, and help menus.

item.title: neovim within bubble
item.description:
The Neovim-in-TUI Symbiosis: Seamlessly Editing Text in Go with Bubble Tea

Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) built in Go are powerful, fast, and portable. Frameworks like Bubble Tea have made creating them more accessible than ever. However, one common challenge is rich text input. While components like the textarea from the Bubbles library are excellent for simple, multi-line input, they can’t compete with the power and familiarity of a dedicated terminal editor like Neovim.
